Publication at the 7th International Conference on the Quality of Information and Communications Technology (QUATIC) in Porto, Portugal

Jonas Trümper presents his paper "Visualization of Multithreaded Behavior to Facilitate Maintenance of Complex Software Systems" (in collaboration with Johannes Bohnet, Stefan Voigt, and Prof. Jürgen Döllner) at the QUATIC 2010 on Sept. 29. The paper will be available in the printed proceedings.

The paper will be available in the printed proceedings.
